# Entry points added by hand because a run of the game reported a jump to an address that was
# not registered.
# Format: one address per line (0x........); the rest of the line after '#' is a free comment.
# The comment should name the journal entry or the log that justified the address.
# tools/pipeline/make_config.py merges this file with config/extra_entry_points.txt (which is
# regenerated by tools/funcmap/find_code_pointers.py and must not be edited by hand).
# An address that is in no row of the function map belongs in config/ghidra_seeds.txt instead.
# Starts with no addresses.
